sources.title: Contrabass README
sources.locator: Current scope; Requirements; How Contrabass works; Supported integrations; Web dashboard and HTTP API
sources.finding: Terminal-first orchestrator for issue-driven agent runs, Go port of OpenAI Symphony; Linear, GitHub Issues and internal board trackers; Codex app-server, OpenCode, oh-my-opencode, OMX and OMC runners; git worktrees; teams; TUI, web dashboard, HTTP and MCP API.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.finding: Strict WORKFLOW.md validation, defaults, contrabass config effective.

sources.title: Orchestrator configuration
sources.finding: Backoff, shutdown, snapshot stage and ETA settings; unconfigurable invariants.

sources.title: Local board tracker
sources.finding: File-based internal board with states todo, in_progress, retry, done, parents, assignees, blocked-by edges, comments and a dispatch loop that picks the oldest runnable issue.

sources.title: Enhanced Team Mode
sources.locator: Features; Comparison with OMX/OMC; Deferred features
sources.finding: Worker health, scaling, events, messaging, task claims, restart; approval system, git worktree support for team workers and merge coordinator are deferred.

sources.title: Codex protocol notes
sources.finding: Documents the JSONL framing used with codex app-server.

sources.title: Web server
sources.finding: Serves the embedded dashboard and JSON/SSE endpoints including stop, board CRUD and MCP stream.

sources.title: MCP streamable HTTP
sources.finding: External MCP agents can call a single tool, contrabass.dashboard_snapshot, with a 24-hour in-memory bearer token.

sources.title: Tracker contract
sources.finding: Linear (GraphQL), GitHub Issues (REST, PRs skipped) and local board adapters.

sources.title: Codex runner
sources.finding: Forwards workflow-level Codex approval policy and sandbox mode as -c overrides to codex app-server.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Checks the GitHub releases API every 12 hours for a newer version; CONTRABASS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK disables it; notification suggests brew upgrade.

sources.title: Workspace manager
sources.finding: Creates a git worktree (or plain directory) under workspaces/<issue-id>.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)
sources.finding: Repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0.

sources.title: GitHub API for junhoyeo/contrabass
sources.finding: Repository has 226 stars, license Apache-2.0, homepage contrabass.dev, last push 2026-07-17.

sources.title: Contrabass v0.5.1 release
sources.finding: v0.5.1 (2026-07-16) assets are macOS and Linux tarballs for amd64 and arm64 plus checksums; no Windows build.

sources.title: Bounded search: pull request creation, review
sources.finding: The only match is a GitHub adapter that skips pull requests when listing issues; no PR creation, review or merge code.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry, webhooks, sandbox
sources.locator: rg -il "telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog|webhook" internal cmd; rg -il "docker|container|bwrap" internal cmd
sources.finding: No telemetry, analytics or webhook code; container/sandbox words appear only in the Codex sandbox-mode passthrough, config and TUI header text.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
sources.finding: No cost or price code; token counts (in/out) are tracked and shown.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: No SSO, roles or presence; the dashboard stream endpoint is tokenless and MCP uses a generated bearer token.

sources.title: Bounded search: cron or schedules
sources.finding: Only tracker polling (poll_interval_ms) and retry backoff; no cron-style scheduler.
